# Test fixture policy

Fixtures must have documented provenance and redistribution permission.

For each committed screenshot fixture, record:

- Source or creator.
- Permission or applicable license.
- Screenshot style.
- Expected cards, counts, and energy.
- Any intentional crop, resize, or compression.

Do not commit Pokémon card artwork copied from the external database merely to make tests convenient. Prefer synthetic geometry fixtures, tiny non-expressive derived data, or locally configured integration tests against an external database.
